falsifiers: the five matching blocks fail to define the frozen canonical S5 action
native V4 is not the pointwise kernel of the duad actions
native V4 fixes every orientation root
native V4 fails to act trivially on inverse root pairs
more than one equivariant unordered-duad bridge exists
root inversion fails to descend to the computed inverse-pair action

authority_reconstruction: the block action has image S5 and kernel native V4
the reconstructed group operation agrees with the exact action set
frozen_tests.enumeration_method: For each transitive source A-set, fix one source basepoint. For every target candidate fixed by the source stabilizer, propagate its image through the complete A action. Retain exactly the well-defined bijective equivariant maps.
equivariant_maps: count all A-equivariant bijections from ordered duads to orientation roots
count all A-equivariant bijections from unordered duads to inverse root pairs
test whether ordered-duad reversal corresponds to root inversion
do not choose a map after inspecting the result
kernel_actions: compute the pointwise kernel on ordered duads
compute the pointwise kernel on unordered duads
compute the pointwise kernel on orientation roots
compute the pointwise kernel on inverse root pairs
test every native V4 element on every root
test whether nontrivial native V4 elements fix roots or exchange inverse partners

outcome_predicates.authority_failure: a frozen authority hash, action cardinality, kernel, or declared certificate check fails
outcome_predicates.computation_failure: the exact group operation or required finite actions cannot be reconstructed consistently
outcome_predicates.multiple_unordered_bridges_with_oriented: the ordered bridge count is zero, the unordered bridge count exceeds one, and the oriented kernel obstruction is verified
outcome_predicates.no_equivariant_unordered_bridge: the ordered bridge count is zero and the unordered bridge count is zero
outcome_predicates.oriented_bridge_exists: at least one A-equivariant bijection exists from ordered duads to roots
outcome_predicates.unique_unordered_bridge_with_oriented_ke: the ordered bridge count is zero, the unordered bridge count is one, native V4 is the duad kernel, native V4 acts trivially on inverse pairs, and some native V4 element exchanges every root with its inverse
outcome_predicates.unordered_bridge_without_verified_kernel: the ordered bridge count is zero, at least one unordered bridge exists, but the proposed native V4 kernel mechanism is not verified

structural_prediction.predicted_mechanism: native V4 acts trivially on visible duads and inverse pairs but nontrivially on roots by exchanging c with c_inverse
structural_prediction.reason_not_blind: Certificate078 already exposes native V4 as the five-point kernel, while Packet011e witness inventories visibly contain native V4 elements among root reversers.
